cases.title: Esc at CD's third point cancels the pipe, draws nothing and opens no pipe window
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with daily card D04 (DAILY_TOOLS_TEST_CASES_2026-10-23.md): cancel line, no window, nothing left in the drawing, cancelled outcome line, contrast run opens New Pipe. The contrast pipe is not drawn, so assertion 3 of the card is only half covered.
cases.expected: After CD with two typed points the command waits for the third point; one Esc prints '[CE] CD command cancelled.', no New Pipe window opens, nothing new is left in the drawing (no polyline, arrow or text), and the Civil log holds one 'Command outcome: CD cancelled'. The contrast run (two points then Enter) opens New Pipe.
cases.why_not_unit: The result depends on AutoCAD's live point prompt answering Esc during real point collection and on nothing being drawn before the pipe window.
not_automated: Phase 3 batch 2: the Enter contrast now places the pipe (levels 18.000 and 17.900, Start Pipe) and counts exactly one new pipe object; the pipe's two vertices are not read.
The exact words of the third-point prompt are recorded, not asserted.
